name: Infrapatellar Branch of Saphenous Neuropathy
definition: Neuropathy of the infrapatellar branch of the saphenous nerve, often after knee surgery, trauma or repetitive local compression.

investigations.principle: Clinical localization is primary; ultrasound or diagnostic block may help.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent neuroma-like pain may need targeted nerve intervention.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu Vata-neuralgic phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Neuropathy of the infrapatellar branch of the saphenous nerve, often after knee surgery, trauma or repetitive local compression.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
